verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service platform, so the sponsor-model axis applies. The evidence pack only implies a bank partner exists ("bank-approved" vendors, "Programs", accounts "at the same bank"). It never says who holds the charter, whether partner banks are named, whether Treasury Prime is a bank, direct program or middleware, or what happens to customers and funds if the platform fails.

support.subject: As a founder, I know exactly who holds the charter — whether the platform is a bank, a direct program with a named partner bank, or middleware between me and someone else's sponsor — and what happens to my customers if the platform fails
